live_task.prompt: Fix validation_material.py so page_window(page=1, page_size=20) returns ((page - 1) * page_size, page_size). Both arguments must be exact Python ints (bool is invalid); page must be at least 1 and page_size must be from 1 through 100 inclusive. Omitted arguments use the stated defaults. Raise TypeError for any non-int value and ValueError for out-of-range integers. Do not coerce values.
